description.en: Highest-starred installable DeepSeek Harness bundles from GitHub topic dsh-plugin, rebuilt automatically. Verified against DSH 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 从 GitHub 话题 dsh-plugin 中挑选的高星、可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 组合包，自动重建。已按 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 校验。

plugins.name: dsh-our-free-model
plugins.title: DSH OUR Free Model
plugins.description: Our Free Model — 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型，桌面端另有 EAC 协付渠道；2.0 起接入 LobsterAI、Qoder、TRAE、Cline、Loomy、Raccoon、MiniMax、ZCode、Gemini 十个账号渠道（原有匿名免费通道保留）（登录、账号池、积分领取、本地 OpenAI 网关与局域网转发、数据看板与运行日志），六页毛玻璃界面统一呈现。
plugins.author: fish-under-sea

plugins.name: dshmarket
plugins.title: Dshmarket
plugins.description: Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins. · DSH 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好。
plugins.author: fkysly

plugins.name: @dsh-external/dsh-super-injector
plugins.title: DSH Super Injector
plugins.description: dsh-routing-suite 分发入口：DSH 超级模组注入器（BepInEx 式运行时注入，免重启）+ router-standard 预设仓库。插件入口为 injector/，预设位于 preset/。

plugins.name: @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui
plugins.title: DSH TUI
plugins.description: Interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness agents, sessions and tools.
plugins.author: chimney

plugins.name: dsh-ops
plugins.title: DSH OPS
plugins.description: Native file and PTC tools for DSH on Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS arm64/x64; Windows-only optional Bash payload and host PowerShell integration
plugins.author: autofx

plugins.name: dsh-better-sidebar
plugins.title: DSH Better Sidebar
plugins.description: Better Sidebar for DSH — file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, separate for every conversation. Also exposes a service other plugins use to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.
plugins.author: huanlin

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
plugins.title: DSH Plugin Wallpaper Engine
plugins.description: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: render your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the chat — Scene and Web in real time through the bundled WebWallGL engine, Video played directly — with iOS-style liquid glass, adjustable blur/scrim/border/opacity, custom typography and caret, and a liquid-glass makeover of the whole settings window. Prerequisite: DeepSeek Harness 0.2 kernel (including 0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2) and Node.js >=22.12.0. No version restriction on dsh-better-sidebar.
plugins.author: chensyovo

plugins.name: dsh-context
plugins.title: DSH Context
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, with context dashboard and context command, for understanding how the context is made of, and how it evolves.
plugins.author: bowenliang123
